rows.note: get_finding_schema_path and load_finding_schema open the schema file, then make_finding, to_dict, and parse_finding_dict round-trip one finding. validate_finding_json does not resolve a path and does not construct a Finding. emitter_to_dict is one object, not that round-trip.

load_finding_schema compares the required set and the property set, including source path, line, and record_id, with the Finding model. validate_finding_json checks one instance. Recording those names in facts is not that loader call.
get_finding_schema_path follows the prefix share directory when the repo schema is hidden. No vector resolves a schema path.
load_finding_schema raises FileNotFoundError when the schema path is missing. validate_finding_json does not open a path.

the test reads the schema file and compares the code, severity, and repairability enums with codes.py as sets. validate_finding_json accepts or rejects one value. One accepted code is not that lockstep sweep.
